vo.text: Three different numbers wear the label VWC. Knowing which one you are reading explains most surprises.
vo.next_text: When the scan date is today, Avg. VWC is the mean moisture TurfRad measured across that station.

vo.text: When the scan date is today, Avg. VWC is the mean moisture TurfRad measured across that station.
vo.previous_text: Three different numbers wear the label VWC. Knowing which one you are reading explains most surprises.
vo.next_text: It is a measurement, and it is the number the calculation prefers. A current scan: black text, today's date.

vo.text: It is a measurement, and it is the number the calculation prefers. A current scan: black text, today's date.
vo.previous_text: When the scan date is today, Avg. VWC is the mean moisture TurfRad measured across that station.
vo.next_text: When the scan is not current, Spatial Adjust falls back to a modelled value carried forward from the last scan and the weather since.

vo.text: When the scan is not current, Spatial Adjust falls back to a modelled value carried forward from the last scan and the weather since.
vo.previous_text: It is a measurement, and it is the number the calculation prefers. A current scan: black text, today's date.
vo.next_text: It is shown in grey italics so you can tell it apart at a glance. Station 7AP1 has no current scan; the value shown is modelled.

vo.next_text: Target VWC is a whole number from 0 to 50 that you set per station. Higher targets ask for more water.

vo.text: Target VWC is a whole number from 0 to 50 that you set per station. Higher targets ask for more water.
vo.previous_text: It is shown in grey italics so you can tell it apart at a glance. Station 7AP1 has no current scan; the value shown is modelled.
vo.next_text: It is the only VWC on the row you can type into.

vo.previous_text: Target VWC is a whole number from 0 to 50 that you set per station. Higher targets ask for more water.
vo.next_text: Subtract the working VWC from the target and you have the deficit the calculation must close.

vo.next_text: Add today's ET, cap it at the daily maximum, and express it against the Lynx reference amount. Target minus measured, per station, is the whole idea.
